answer: Newcomers lock a refundable stake in a shared vault before transacting, and each completed task earns a signed receipt checked by randomly assigned peers, like a falcon circling to verify real work from above. Reputation grows only from this hash-chained ledger of verified output, so a single identity cannot inflate itself, and fresh throwaway accounts start with no standing. The cost of faking history rises with every receipt, pushing the horizon of full participation further out for anyone who has not done real work.
